newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's De Benedetti under new investigation.
newsitem.headline: Italy's De Benedetti under new investigation.

text.p: Former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti is under preliminary investigation for suspected accounting fraud, judicial sources said on Friday.
De Benedetti and other managers connected with Olivetti are already being investigated for making misleading statements in connection with Olivetti's accounts for the first half of 1996.
Former Olivetti chief executive officer Corrado Passera is also the target of a preliminary investigation into accounting fraud, the sources said.

Passera resigned suddenly from Olivetti in June. Others under investigation for making misleading statements include his successor Francesco Caio, chairman Antonio Tesone and financial manager Giorgio Airaudo.
